thread:
Jamal: Heads up — opened PR #41234 to bump SLOs for short-running infer jobs and add a DB migration for token-usage counters. Need runtime + infra + security signoff before we schedule a canary. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pulls/41234

Priya: Looking now. Quick Q — does the migration lock a table for >30s? db-migrate shows it's a create table + index. If it's online add, should be fine.

Tomas: runtime note — batch size bump looks safe but need to run perf microbench at seq len 64/128. Also: add a feature flag please in config so we can roll back without deploy.

Jamal: Good call. I'll add feature flag and perf numbers. Migration is CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS token_counters; index on (model_name). No long locks expected. @Tomas I'll paste bench results once done.

Olivia: Security: need to confirm the migration doesn't expose counters to non-admin queries. Also how are keys used for the counters' webhook? If any KMS usage or secrets touched, ping sec-infra. Can you also add a short risk note in PR description? :eyes: 

Jamal: counter endpoints will be internal-only; no KMS changes. I'll add risk note and ACLs. Feature flag name: slo_short_seq_v2. Will add perf numbers and submit an update by EOD.

deploy-bot: Canaries scheduled must include rollback plan. Use `/canary schedule --pr 41234 --window 2h --team runtime` once approvals done.

Priya: LGTM from infra after a quick schema sanity check — no locks. @Olivia are you ok with the ACL note or want us to block until we have a design doc?

Olivia: ACL note is fine for now, please include who runs the rotate/revoke steps in the playbook. If no KMS touches, I'm fine to approve after that edit. :+1: 

Jamal: thanks all. I'll update PR and ping again. Targeting canary 08:00 PST tomorrow. @Tomas please run perf bench when you have a minute.
